title.description: The title at the top of the connect page: the church's elders, and how to reach and find the church.

description.defaultMessage: We’d love to meet you. Here are the people to ask for, and how to reach us.
description.description: The line under the connect page's title, inviting the reader to get in touch with the church.

head.description: The connect page's title as the browser's tab and search engines show it: the page, then the church's name.

visit.description: The heading of the connect page's card with the church's address, phone number, fax number and email.

address.description: The label before the church's street address, on the connect page.

phone.description: The label before the church's phone number, on the connect page.

fax.description: The label before the church's fax number, on the connect page.

email.description: The label before the church's email address, on the connect page.

hours.description: The heading of the connect page's card with the hours the church's office is open.

open.description: The office's hours on the days it is open all day.

friday.description: The office's hours on Friday, when it closes at noon.

closed.description: The days the church's office is closed.

map.description: The accessible name of the map on the connect page. `address` is the church's full street address, already written out.
